text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about speeding along their street, and requested that traffic calming measures (speed bumps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns. My office polled the homes and there was strong support from the residents for making this change. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Amsterdam Avenue, between Westview Blvd and Victoria Park Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Amsterdam Avenue, between Westview Boulevard and Victoria Park Avenue. 2. Direced the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install seven speed humps on Amsterdam Avenue, between Westview Boulevard and Victoria Park Avenue, generally as shown on the attached Drawing Nos. TC-101 and TC-102, dated November 2022 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
